title: 12South| Balcony + Free Parking| Near Downtown -10
description:
Stay in the heart of Nashville’s iconic 12South neighborhood, steps from popular restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, and local favorites. This stylish 1BR apartment features a private balcony, FREE parking, fully equipped kitchen, and complimentary local coffee. Enjoy Malin+Goetz luxury bath products for an elevated stay. Perfect for couples and solo travelers looking to experience 12South, Music City, and Nashville’s top attractions.

The space
– 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom (sleeps 2)
– King bed with fresh linens + room-darkening shades
– Balcony overlooking 12th Ave South
– Fully equipped kitchen w/ stove, oven, dishwasher + coffee maker
– Complimentary local coffee provided
– Smart HDTV + fast WiFi
– Dedicated workspace for remote guests
– Washer + dryer in unit
– Central A/C + ceiling fan
– Free parking on premises + street parking
– Metro Permit #2018-068-094

Guest access
– Entire apartment + private balcony
– Keyless self check-in via keypad
– Free parking in lot or on street

Other things to note
– Located in the heart of 12South—urban sounds & construction may be present
– Exterior cameras monitor parking area for security
– No parties or unauthorized guests
– Quiet hours: 10PM–7AM
